column1: # MemRadar Price Index: monthly price levels by segment

column4: comment.char='#'). DuckDB: a saved copy reads as is; reading from the URL needs SET force_download=true first. Spreadsheets show these lines as text rows above the data.

column1: # WHAT THIS IS: one row per segment per month. median_price_usd is the median retail price across the products MemRadar tracked that month. median_usd_per_gb is the median of each product's price divided by its total capacity (a 2x16GB kit is 32GB). product_count is how many products the row is computed over.

column2: NOT A MEASURE OF CHANGE. A change computed between two rows of this file will NOT equal the MemRadar Price Index for the same period
column3: and when measured in September 2026 it differed from the index by as much as 44 percentage points. The Price Index compares each product with itself; this file compares whichever products were tracked in each month. For how much prices changed over a period
column4: cite the Price Index at memradar.com/price-index/

column1: # SURVIVORSHIP: the tracked catalog was assembled in July 2026
column2: so historical rows contain only products still sold in 2026. They describe those products
column3: not the whole market as it stood at the time.

column1: # METHOD: only real price observations are used; days a product had no offer are excluded. Each product contributes one value per month (the median of its daily prices)
column2: so products observed more often do not outweigh the rest. A segment's series begins at the first month from which it never falls below 10 products; use product_count to apply a stricter bar. The current month is excluded until it is complete. Full methodology: memradar.com/methodology/

column1: # SEGMENTS: ddr5 and ddr4 are memory kits and modules; nvme_ssd and sata_ssd are solid state drives. A drive is classed as SATA first
column2: so an M.2 SATA drive counts as sata_ssd.

column1: # SOURCES: Amazon price history licensed from Keepa. These figures are medians computed by MemRadar from that history
column2: not the raw licensed data. Newegg prices are not included: MemRadar records Newegg as a current price only and holds no Newegg history.
